entries.title: Pig dreams (돼지꿈)
entries.content: A pig dream is the classic money dream in Korea; some people buy a lottery ticket the next day.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: Pregnancy dreams (태몽)
entries.content: Taemong are dreams said to announce a pregnancy. Dragons, tigers, fruit and jewels are common, and families retell them for years.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: Fire dreams
entries.content: A big fire in a dream is usually read as prosperity and rising fortune, not danger.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: Poop dreams
entries.content: Odd but true: dreaming of poop is read as incoming money or good luck.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: Teeth falling out
entries.content: Read as worry about family or health in folklore. Most dream experts see it as everyday stress.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: Clear water
entries.content: Clean, flowing water is read as a smooth path ahead; muddy water as confusion to sort out.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection

entries.title: A note on dreams
entries.content: Dream meanings are folklore for fun and reflection. They don't predict the future.
entries.label: Folklore - for fun and reflection
